reviews.comment: This guy is clearly unaware of how to teach/motivate students. Quiz/hw answers are required to list monotonous details such as a million assumptions and a problem 'reflection' to discuss what you learned on every problem. He rushes thru lecture and refuses to post his notes so good luck if you miss a key detail. As soon as I show up I want to leave
